receipt_hints: Hungarian NAV till receipts print each item with a VAT letter (A/B/C/D/E) after the price. 'ÖSSZESEN' or 'FIZETENDŐ' is the total. 'Kerekítés' is cash rounding to 5 HUF. 'ADÓSZÁM' is the vendor tax number. Dates are printed YYYY.MM.DD. Restaurant bills often print no VAT letter per line; instead an 'ÁFA bontás' table lists rate (5 or 27), net, VAT and gross. Ignore EUR conversions; use the HUF amounts. The footer often names the till software company (e.g. GastroMASTER), which is not the vendor; if no shop name is printed, use "Unknown".
